[IDSP.2.4] Stream event:
`ds_recorder_emit_action_log(engine, level, category, message)`
fires **before** the typed callback so a stream
subscriber sees the log even if the typed cb returns
an error. The
stream is the audit trail, the typed callback is the
routing. ACTION_LOG fires whether or not a typed log
callback is registered. ACTION_LOG does NOT fire on
arg-decode failures (bad level, wrong arg count) per
[IDSP.1.4].
